studies.title: Wayfinding by stars and swells
studies.caption: Navigators steer by the rising and setting points of stars, read ocean swells through the hull and watch birds and clouds for land, all held in memory, not on paper.
studies.prompt: View from the low deck of an early Polynesian voyaging canoe near Tonga about1000BCE at twilight: navigator seated studying a few rising stars above the horizon, parallel long swells visible below, woven sail at edge; no compass, telescope, written star map, or fantasy constellations.
